record_type_quote: The present study attempted to closely replicate who found, in part, a compensatory effect such that individuals with spouses higher in conscientiousness reported higher self-rated health and fewer physical limitations in the Health and Retirement Study. Using similarly structured data from the National Social Life, Health, and Aging Project (N = 953), the current study found results largely consistent with the original study such that partner conscientiousness predicted both self-rated health and physical limitations, and husbands’ conscientiousness and neuroticism interacted when predicting wives’ self-rated health. A discussion of the usefulness of statistical significance versus effect size in replication follows.

targets.title: Compensatory conscientiousness and health in older couples.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study attempted to closely replicate who found, in part, a compensatory effect such that individuals with spouses higher in conscientiousness reported higher self-rated health and fewer physical limitations in the Health and Retirement Study. Using similarly structured data from the National Social Life, Health, and Aging Project (N = 953), the current study found results largely consistent with the original study such that partner conscientiousness predicted both self-rated health and physical limitations, and husbands’ conscientiousness and neuroticism interacted when predicting wives’ self-rated health. targets.outcome_quote: In this direct replication of, we found very similar results: (1) Conscientiousness and emotional stability predicted better ratings of health; (2) partner conscientiousness predicted better self-ratings of health in most cases; and (3) the most notable result of the original study, husbands’ conscientiousness and neuroticism interacted to predict better ratings of health in wives was also replicated. While the study did not conform to some ideal replication recommendations (e.g., having 2.5 times the number of subjects in the original study), the unique structure of the data provided an ideal opportunity to conduct as direct of a replication possible of an effect that would presumably be quite difficult to test otherwise.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion gives an overall verdict of very similar results for the direct replication, taking precedence over individual departures.
